name: folio-vscode
description: Papyrus language support powered by the Folio language server

folio.server.path.description: Absolute path to the Folio executable or its directory. Folio is resolved from this setting, then PATH; the repository's target/debug build is used only in extension development.

folio.server.manifestPath.description: Optional folio.toml path, absolute or relative to the open workspace folder.

folio.server.logFilter.description: Rust tracing filter passed to folio lsp; logs are written to stderr.

folio.editor.hover.documentation.description: Show Papyrus declaration documentation, language explanations, examples and reference links in hover, and documentation in completion details. Applies without restarting the language server.

folio.editor.hover.details.description: Show literal values, the symbol owner, selected provider, source and navigation links in hover. Applies without restarting the language server.

folio.editor.codeLens.enabled.description: Show Folio CodeLens above declarations. Applies without restarting the language server.

folio.editor.codeLens.references.description: Show project reference counts in Folio CodeLens.

folio.editor.codeLens.implementations.description: Show inheritance and implementation navigation in Folio CodeLens.

folio.editor.codeLens.source.description: Show source and declaration links in Folio CodeLens.

folio.editor.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter name hints for positional Papyrus call arguments. VS Code's editor.inlayHints.enabled setting also applies.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test tests/editorOptions.cjs tests/serverStatus.cjs
